$comment: Fleet registry for the /orchestrate skill. Committed: the fleet shape is a project fact.
Secrets never live here. SSH uses key auth resolved by the OS agent; no passwords, no
connection strings. 'repo' is that machine's checkout path, not this machine's.
Paths use forward slashes - .NET, pwsh, and git all accept them on Windows, and it keeps
this file free of backslash-escaping bugs.
Hostnames do NOT indicate form factor. Windows auto-names most PCs DESKTOP-XXXXXXX;
box3 reports DESKTOP-F5LK8MA but is physically a laptop (PCSystemType=Mobile, internal
battery). Recorded here so nobody re-derives it from the name and gets it wrong.
local  - same machine as the orchestrator. Bash/pwsh directly.
ssh    - headless. `ssh <target> claude -p ...`. Structured JSON back. Needs sshd + key auth.
rc     - Remote Control. That box runs `claude --remote-control`, signed into the same
Anthropic account; drive it with SendMessage, not with a shell. rcSessionName is
a HINT ONLY - the name changes every time the session restarts, so always confirm
against a live ListAgents before dispatching.
enabled:false means the transport is declared but not yet provisioned. /orchestrate must
refuse to dispatch to it and say which setup step is missing - never silently fall back.

machines.notes: Orchestrator host. The ONLY machine with XAMPP/MariaDB 10.4.32, so every card touching the database, a migration, or the running API belongs here (ADR-013 pins the three DB identities to this host).

PROVISIONED 2026-08-23 for RC work; L4 pre-commit hook installed, session runs inside the checkout. CONNECTIVITY: ethernet ONLY - this box has no working wireless and is cabled to the Huawei 5G router, so (a) it is reachable only when box1 is on that same router, i.e. AT HOME, and is UNAVAILABLE at school or anywhere box1 is on a different network - do not place demo-day or away-from-home cards here; (b) all of its internet is mobile data through that router, so any download it makes is metered. SSH transport BLOCKED: sshd.exe dies at the Windows loader (0xC0000135). That is the ONLY reproducible symptom - ScanHealth, sfc, signature validation and the DISM CLI are all clean, and the two other 'symptoms' first reported here were retracted. Cause unknown, cheap fixes exhausted, transport CLOSED unsolved. Untried and free if ever wanted: dism remove-capability then re-add, sourced from the local component store. No XAMPP/MariaDB by design (ADR-013 pins the DB to box1). Git credential cached by a one-time interactive sign-in; an RC session has no TTY and can never establish one itself.

SSH TRANSPORT LIVE, proven end to end 2026-08-23 (SMOKE-02, haiku/low, $0.069). Addressed as the ssh_config Host alias `box3`; user, identity file and hostname live in box1's ~/.ssh/config, not here. Key-only auth, PasswordAuthentication no, sshd firewall rule scoped to 192.168.100.0/24 - the subnet, not a single IP, because DHCP will move box1 eventually and a rule pinned to one lease fails silently later. Store/MSIX pwsh resolves fine under a non-interactive SSH login - that risk did not materialise. Health-gated before install: DISM CLI works, signature validation Valid, sfc's only finding a cosmetic Default-profile OneDrive.lnk. PCSystemType=2 (Mobile) - a LAPTOP despite the DESKTOP- hostname; read formFactor from here, never from the name. The only secondary that exists away from home: box2 is cabled to the house router with no wireless, so at school the fleet is box1 + box3. 57.8 GB free is the tightest disk - place disk-heavy work elsewhere. Owns documentations/.
